ruleDefinitions.name: HackTool - Rubeus Execution - ScriptBlock
ruleDefinitions.description: Detects the execution of the hacktool Rubeus using specific command line flags Note: Unmapped fields: ScriptBlockText

sequences.query: (ScriptBlockText = RGX(".*asreproast\\ .*") OR ScriptBlockText = RGX(".*dump\\ \\/service\\:krbtgt\\ .*") OR ScriptBlockText = RGX(".*dump\\ \\/luid\\:0x.*") OR ScriptBlockText = RGX(".*kerberoast\\ .*") OR ScriptBlockText = RGX(".*createnetonly\\ \\/program\\:.*") OR ScriptBlockText = RGX(".*ptt\\ \\/ticket\\:.*") OR ScriptBlockText = RGX(".*\\/impersonateuser\\:.*") OR ScriptBlockText = RGX(".*renew\\ \\/ticket\\:.*") OR ScriptBlockText = RGX(".*asktgt\\ \\/user\\:.*") OR ScriptBlockText = RGX(".*harvest\\ \\/interval\\:.*") OR ScriptBlockText = RGX(".*s4u\\ \\/user\\:.*") OR ScriptBlockText = RGX(".*s4u\\ \\/ticket\\:.*") OR ScriptBlockText = RGX(".*hash\\ \\/password\\:.*") OR ScriptBlockText = RGX(".*golden\\ \\/aes256\\:.*") OR ScriptBlockText = RGX(".*silver\\ \\/user\\:.*"))
